scenario_name: Customer demands immediate card lock before anything else due to active fraud
judge_summary: The assistant handled an urgent card theft scenario effectively by promptly locking the card and arranging a rush replacement with clear confirmation details. It maintained consistent context and a reassuring, efficient tone, resulting in a smooth, goal-focused interaction. No major issues are evident in the conversation flow or responses.

bot: Hello! What can I assist you with today?

transcript.user: Someone is using my card right now at an ATM! I need you to lock it immediately!
bot: I’m on it—one moment while I pull up your card options.
Your River Visa ending 4821 is now locked, and any new transactions will be declined.
Would you like me to add the replacement card to a digital wallet for immediate use—Apple Pay or Google Pay?

transcript.user: No, don’t add it to a digital wallet. Also, my card was stolen so I need a replacement sent.
bot: Got it—give me a moment to check shipping options.

transcript.user: Please use rush shipping, I really need the replacement asap.
bot: Okay—would you like me to go ahead and place the replacement order with rush shipping?

transcript.user: Yes, please place the rush replacement order now.
bot: Alright—one moment while I confirm that.

All set. Your replacement card has been ordered:
Order ID: RPL-2026-001843
Card: River Visa ending 4821
Shipping: rush
Estimated delivery: 1-2 business days
Can I help with anything else?

transcript.user: No, that’s all. Thanks for taking care of it so fast.
bot: Were you satisfied with the assistance you received today?

task_completion_reasoning: The assistant clearly locked the existing card and confirmed placement of a rush replacement order with concrete details.
